question: Should OpenClaw accept real-time multi-operator dashboard presence as a bundled dashboard-plugin feature after the Wave 1 dashboard substrate lands?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing collaboration behavior and exposes operator presence/editing state, so automation cannot decide the product and privacy scope before maintainers settle the dashboard direction.

options.title: Stage After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Wave 2 design item and revisit once the dashboard backend/UI/custom-widget stack is accepted or rejected.

options.title: Sponsor Now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the feature now and define event payload, auth scope, privacy, and edit-state semantics before implementation.

options.title: Route Outside Core
options.body: If bundled dashboard work is not accepted, require this to live in an external plugin or ClawHub package rather than OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Stage After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Wave 2 design item and revisit once the dashboard backend/UI/custom-widget stack is accepted or rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main owner signal for gateway presence, plugin event scoping, and the Control UI plugin-tab seam this feature would reuse.
